proposal.reason: Main change adds a new bundled TROCE GIN backend/plugin (`libpccl-gin-troce.so`) with substantial host/device GIN implementation, plugin loading/discovery, new GIN type IDs, and GIN signal semantics (`SignalSet`) integration. Additional `network` review is needed because shared IB transport code is substantively changed (provider detection, QP inline configuration, and proxy send-path behavior/opcode handling in `src/transport/net_ib/*`), not just mechanical call-site updates.
